info.title: TLITODOS Backend API
info.description: FastAPI endpoint server for the TLITODOS shared todo-list app. This OpenAPI document is written for frontend and AI-agent consumption: field names match the JSON API contract, authenticated operations use BearerAuth, and upload endpoints explicitly document multipart/form-data.

tags.name: authorization
tags.description: Google login, current user profile, notifications, and Discord linking

tags.name: categories
tags.description: Per-user todo categories. A user can create up to 5 categories.

tags.name: todos
tags.description: Todo CRUD, subtasks, dependencies, and todo-scoped bet creation

tags.name: bets
tags.description: Bet status, proof upload, and verification

tags.name: diaries
tags.description: Diary entries with optional image uploads

post.summary: Log in with Google access token
post.description: Validates a Google access token, creates or updates the user, stores an API access token and refresh token, and returns the TLITODOS token pair.
Rotates a valid refresh token and returns a new access token plus a new refresh token. The submitted refresh token is revoked.
Revokes the submitted refresh token when it exists and is not already revoked.

patch.description: Accepts either JSON fields or multipart/form-data. Multipart uses field name image and returns profileImageUrl as /uploads/profiles/{filename}.

post.description: Exchanges a Discord OAuth authorization code for user information and stores the linked Discord username.

200.description: Groups the current user belongs to.

get.description: Returns only the invite code for a group the current user belongs to.

delete.description: Only a LEADER can remove another member. The leader cannot remove themselves through this endpoint.

get.description: Returns the current user's categories by default. To view another member's categories, provide both userId and a groupId shared by the requester and that member.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Shared group id. Required with userId when viewing another member's categories.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Category owner user id. Omit to view the current user's categories.

200.description: Categories owned by the requested user.
Category updated. isDeletable is not included in this endpoint response.

delete.description: Non-deletable default categories, such as 취미, cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the current user's todos by default. To view another member's todos, provide both userId and a groupId shared by the requester and that member; only GROUP and PUBLIC todos are returned for another member.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by dueDate string. When provided, the backend returns todos whose dueDate equals this value plus todos whose dueDate is null.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Todo owner user id. Omit to view the current user's todos. When specified for another user, groupId is required and only GROUP or PUBLIC todos are returned.

patch.description: A todo can be completed only when all subtasks are completed.

post.description: Adds dependencyTodoId to the todo dependencies array. Todos in category id 1 cannot be linked as dependencies.

patch.description: When approved is true, the bet status becomes VERIFIED.

post.description: Accepts either JSON or multipart/form-data. Multipart image uploads return imageUrl as /uploads/diaries/{filename}.

BearerAuth.description: Use the accessToken returned by POST /api/v1/auth/google as Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.

UnauthorizedError.description: Missing, expired, or invalid bearer token.

imageUrl.description: Static upload path such as /uploads/diaries/{filename}, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

googleAccessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from the frontend login flow.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token returned by login or token refresh. Send this in the request body, not in the Authorization header.
Opaque token used with POST /api/v1/auth/refresh and POST /api/v1/auth/logout.

expiresAt.description: UTC datetime string without timezone suffix, generated by the backend.

refreshToken.description: New opaque refresh token. The refresh token submitted in the request has been revoked.

expiresAt.description: Access token expiration as a UTC datetime string without timezone suffix.

refreshExpiresAt.description: Refresh token expiration as a UTC datetime string without timezone suffix.

dueDate.description: Stored as a string. Use a consistent frontend format such as YYYY-MM-DD.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

x-ai-agent-notes: Most endpoints except /ping, /api/v1/auth/google, /api/v1/auth/refresh, and /api/v1/auth/logout require Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.
POST /api/v1/auth/google returns accessToken and refreshToken. Use accessToken in the Authorization header, and use refreshToken only in the JSON body of refresh/logout requests.
The backend uses camelCase JSON field names in request/response bodies even though many Python model attributes are snake_case.
Upload URLs are relative static paths served from /uploads.
GET /api/v1/todos with date={value} returns todos matching that dueDate and todos with dueDate=null.

GET /api/v1/categories and GET /api/v1/todos accept optional userId. Viewing another user's data also requires groupId, and both users must be members of that group. For another user's todos, only GROUP and PUBLIC visibility values are returned.
GET /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/invite-code returns only groupId and inviteCode for lightweight invite-code display.
The backend currently stores dueDate, createdAt, completedAt, expiresAt, refreshExpiresAt, and diary createdAt as strings rather than strict date-time schema values.
PATCH /api/v1/users/me and POST /api/v1/diaries accept multiple content types; choose multipart/form-data only when uploading an image.
